context_inputs.name: official_placement_authority
context_inputs.method: Independent Nevada authority/provenance review of device placement; unresolved until supplied

context_inputs.name: placement_provenance_record
context_inputs.method: Hash-checked authored device schedule availability; authority unverified

limitations: Authored OpenDRIVE type 206 and Native landmark do not prove official placement

CPU replay proves request and saved processing, not original Native outcome
